import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007;
    static long N, K;
    static List<List<List<Long>>>[][] mat = new ArrayList[70][35];

    static class Matrix {
        List<List<Long>> A;

        Matrix() {
            A = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            A = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    row.add(0L);
                }
                A.add(row);
            }
        }

        Matrix(int n) {
            this(n, n);
        }

        int height() {
            return A.size();
        }

        int width() {
            return A.get(0).size();
        }

        List<Long> getRow(int k) {
            return A.get(k);
        }

        Long get(int i, int j) {
            return A.get(i).get(j);
        }

        void set(int i, int j, Long val) {
            A.get(i).set(j, val);
        }

        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                mat.set(i, i, 1L);
            }
            return mat;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = width();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    long val = (get(i, j) + B.get(i, j)) % mod;
                    set(i, j, val);
                }
            }
            return this;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = width();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    long val = (get(i, j) - B.get(i, j) + mod) % mod;
                    set(i, j, val);
                }
            }
            return this;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            int n = height(), m = B.width(), p = width();
            List<List<Long>> C = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    row.add(0L);
                }
                C.add(row);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        sum += get(i, k) * B.get(k, j);
                    }
                    C.get(i).set(j, sum % mod);
                }
            }
            A = C;
            return this;
        }

        Matrix power(long k) {
            Matrix B = identity(height());
            Matrix base = this;
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                    B.multiply(base);
                }
                base.multiply(base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            A = B.A;
            return this;
        }
    }

    static long power_mod(long a, long b) {
        if (b == 0) return 1;
        long res = power_mod(a, b / 2);
        res = (res * res) % mod;
        if ((b & 1) == 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        long temp = N;
        long index = 0;
        while (temp >= K) {
            index++;
            temp /= K;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                mat[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        // Initialize mat[0][0]
        List<List<Long>> baseMat = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                row.add(0L);
            }
            baseMat.add(row);
        }
        baseMat.get(0).set(0, 1L);
        mat[0][0] = new ArrayList<>();
        mat[0][0].addAll(baseMat);

        // Generate other matrices
        for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
            List<List<Long>> prevMat = mat[0][i - 1];
            List<List<Long>> newMat = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int r = 0; r < K; r++) {
                List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int c = 0; c < K; c++) {
                    row.add(prevMat.get((r + 1) % K).get((c + 1) % K));
                }
                newMat.add(row);
            }
            mat[0][i] = newMat;
        }

        for (int idx = 1; idx <= index; idx++) {
            mat[idx][0] = new ArrayList<>();
            mat[idx][0].addAll(mat[idx - 1][0]);
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                List<List<Long>> multiplied = multiplyMatrices(mat[idx - 1][i], mat[idx][0]);
                mat[idx][0] = multiplied;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[idx][i] = new ArrayList<>();
                mat[idx][i].addAll(mat[idx][i - 1]);
                List<List<Long>> tempMat = mat[idx][i];
                List<List<Long>> rotated = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int r = 0; r < K; r++) {
                    List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int c = 0; c < K; c++) {
                        row.add(tempMat.get((r + 1) % K).get((c + 1) % K));
                    }
                    rotated.add(row);
                }
                mat[idx][i] = rotated;
            }
        }

        long[] ans = new long[(int) (K + 1)];
        ans[(int) K] = 1;
        int used = 0;
        long currentIndex = index;
        while (currentIndex >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0; ; i++) {
                if (power_mod(K, currentIndex) <= N) {
                    N -= power_mod(K, currentIndex);
                    ans = multiplyMatrixVector(mat[(int) currentIndex][used], ans);
                    used++;
                    used %= K;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            currentIndex--;
        }

        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            total += ans[i];
        }
        total %= mod;
        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }

    static List<List<Long>> multiplyMatrices(List<List<Long>> A, List<List<Long>> B) {
        int n = A.size();
        int m = B.get(0).size();
        int p = A.get(0).size();
        List<List<Long>> C = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            List<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                row.add(0L);
            }
            C.add(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                    sum += A.get(i).get(k) * B.get(k).get(j);
                }
                C.get(i).set(j, sum % mod);
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static long[] multiplyMatrixVector(List<List<Long>> matrix, long[] vector) {
        int n = matrix.size();
        int m = matrix.get(0).size();
        long[] result = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                sum += matrix.get(i).get(j) * vector[j];
            }
            result[i] = sum % mod;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
